title: Q4 Bread for FCI Cumberland, MD FY26
agency: JUSTICE, DEPARTMENT OF.FEDERAL PRISON SYSTEM / BUREAU OF PRISONS.FCI CUMBERLAND
description_text: FY26 4th Quarter Bread for FCI Cumberland in Cumberland, MD. Weekly deliveries of fresh bread, hamburger buns, and hot dog buns to Cumberland, MD. Food Services Administrator will contact weekly to give weekly amounts needed. Solicitation is for total amount needed for the quarter. Delivery dates start July 1, 2026 and end September 30, 2026. Quotes are due May 27, 2026 at 12:00 PM Award will be made on best value. Price, past performance, and specifications will be evaluated. Please email quotes to Brian Logsdon at blogsdon@bop.gov Any questions regarding specifications please email Travis Schneider, Food Services Administrator at tschneider@bop.gov
